senses.definition: A type of shelter prepared from a light sheet of cloth that is used instead of a tent.
A type of tent designed without any poles and made of a waterproofed cotton sheet.
senses.example: According to the present book the German and Austrian mountaineers carry a Zdarsky tent-sack.

senses.definition: An oil obtained from Geranium macrorrhizum, used in perfumery.
